parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
coach[koutʃ]n.
A coach is a person who teaches sports.
→ My coach gets very excited during games.
😎
control[kəntróul]v.
To control something is to make it do what you want.
→ To control the TV, just push the buttons.
😎
description[diskrípʃən]n.
A description of someone or something says what they are like.
→ I gave a description of the man with the gun and hat to the police.
😎
direct[dirékt]adj.
If something is direct, it goes straight between two places.
→ The green path is a direct route to my house.
😎
exam[igzǽm]n.
An exam is a test.
→ I did some practice questions for the math exam on the board.
😎
example[igzǽmpl]n.
An example of something is a thing that is typical of it.
→ Cola is an example of a soft drink.
😎
limit[límit]n.
A limit is the largest or smallest amount of something that you allow.
→ My mother put a limit on how much I could use the phone.
😎
local[lóukəl]adj.
If something is local, it is nearby.
→ The local market in my neighborhood sells all the food we need.
😎
magical[mǽdʒikəl]adj.
Magical describes a quality that makes someone or something special.
→ The fireworks made the night sky look so magical.
😎
mail[meil]n.
Mail is letters and other things sent to people.
→ I get a lot of mail because I have friends all over the world.
😎
novel[nɑ́vəl]n.
A novel is a book that tells a story.
→ He wrote a great novel about ancient China.
😎
outline[áutlàin]n.
An outline is the plan for a story or essay.
→ Before I wrote my essay, I made an outline.
😎
poet[póuit]n.
A poet is a person who writes poems.
→ William Shakespeare was one of the greatest poets.
😎
print[print]v.
To print something is to put it onto paper.
→ Make sure that you print your name clearly.
😎
scene[siːn]n.
A scene is one part of a book or movie.
→ A movie is made up of many short pieces or scenes.
😎
sheet[ʃiːt]n.
A sheet is a thin flat piece of paper.
→ I only needed a single sheet of paper to do my homework.
😎
silly[síli]adj.
If someone or something is silly, they show a lack of thought.
→ I made a silly mistake of dropping mom’s vase.
😎
store[stɔːr]n.
A store is a place where you can buy things.
→ I picked up a few things at the grocery store.
😎
suffer[sʌ́fər]v.
To suffer is to feel pain.
→ Her headache made her suffer all day.
😎
technology[teknɑ́lədʒi]n.
Technology is new things made by using science.
→ He loves technology such as laptop computers.

sections.title: Part A: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. He got a low score on the science test. (ex[1])
questions.explanation: exam (bài kiểm tra) tương đồng với test.

questions.content: 2. The evening was filled with special things that made it different. (ma[2])
questions.explanation: magical (kỳ diệu) miêu tả những điều đặc biệt làm cho nó khác biệt.

questions.content: 3. He loves to have the best things that are new to the world. (tech[3])
questions.explanation: technology (công nghệ) liên quan đến những thứ tốt nhất và mới nhất trên thế giới.

questions.content: 4. I only read the plan for the story. (ou[4])
questions.explanation: outline (đề cương) tương đồng với plan for the story.

questions.content: 5. The writer is good at making sentences about what someone looks like. (de[5])
questions.explanation: descriptions (sự miêu tả) là việc tạo ra các câu văn về vẻ ngoài của ai đó.

sections.title: Part B: Check the better response to each question.

questions.content: 1. Have you been to the local cinema?
options: Yes, I went there yesterday.
No, it is in the other city.
questions.explanation: local nghĩa là địa phương, nên đáp án 'No, it is in the other city' không hợp lý.

questions.content: 2. Will you go to the store?
options: No, I saw it yesterday.
Yes, I need a new hat.
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, I need a new hat.
questions.explanation: Đến cửa hàng (store) để mua mũ mới (need a new hat) là hợp lý.

questions.content: 3. Do you like the new coach?
options: Yes, he’s very nice.
No, it is too expensive.
questions.explanation: coach (huấn luyện viên) là người, nên trả lời 'Yes, he's very nice'.

questions.content: 4. What was your favorite scene?
options: I didn’t like any of them.
I bought it last week.
questions.correctAnswer: I didn’t like any of them.
questions.explanation: Cảnh phim (scene) không thể mua được nên đáp án mua nó tuần trước là sai.

questions.content: 5. Did you buy the novel?
options: Yes, he was very nice.
No, someone gave it to me.
questions.correctAnswer: No, someone gave it to me.
questions.explanation: novel (tiểu thuyết) là đồ vật nên không thể là 'he was very nice'.

sections.title: Part C: Check the one that suits the blank naturally.

questions.content: 1. I like to read, __________.
options: so I buy many novels
so I am a poet
questions.explanation: Thích đọc thì mua nhiều tiểu thuyết (novels).

questions.content: 2. He doesn’t always use the best judgment, __________.
options: she suffers a lot
so he makes some silly mistakes
questions.correctAnswer: so he makes some silly mistakes
questions.explanation: Không suy xét kỹ thì sẽ mắc những lỗi ngớ ngẩn (silly mistakes).

questions.content: 3. He has many computers. __________.
options: They are on sheets
He loves technology
questions.explanation: Có nhiều máy tính chứng tỏ yêu công nghệ (technology).

questions.content: 4. I don’t play on the soccer team __________.
options: because I don’t like the coach
because the outline is too long
questions.correctAnswer: because I don’t like the coach
questions.explanation: Không chơi bóng đá vì không thích huấn luyện viên (coach).

questions.content: 5. She likes her teacher. __________.
options: He uses helpful examples
He writes a lot of mail in class
questions.explanation: Giáo viên thường dùng ví dụ (examples) hữu ích.

questions.content: 6. The movie was too boring. __________.
options: They shouldn’t have printed it
It needed more exciting scenes
questions.explanation: Phim nhàm chán thì cần những cảnh (scenes) thú vị hơn.

questions.content: 7. My dog won’t bite you. _________.
options: I can control it
He is doing an exam
questions.explanation: Chó không cắn vì tôi có thể kiểm soát (control) nó.

questions.content: 8. I need to buy some food, so _________.
options: I’m going to the store
I am over the limit
questions.explanation: Mua đồ ăn thì đến cửa hàng (store).

questions.content: 9. She doesn’t like that book because _________.
options: she has a local book
the examples are not clear enough
questions.correctAnswer: the examples are not clear enough
questions.explanation: Không thích quyển sách vì ví dụ (examples) không rõ ràng.

questions.content: 10. When he travels, __________.
options: he always takes a direct flight
he gives a description of airplanes
questions.correctAnswer: he always takes a direct flight
questions.explanation: Du lịch thì hay bay chuyến bay thẳng (direct flight).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
A Magical Book

Sarah loved to read. She read novels and poems. She loved the beautiful descriptions and phrases. She loved reading work from poets and novelists. She didn’t like video games or technology. She was on the basketball team, but she didn’t like sports. Her parents made her play basketball. In fact, Sarah’s parents made her do many things. But she didn’t want to do those things. She just wanted to sit and read all day.

One day, a small book came in the mail. It was for Sarah. The book looked very special. It was printed on sheets of gold. Sarah began to read. The outline of the story was simple. It was about a magical place. Strange things happened there. One example from the book was about a boy who could control people. In one scene, he made his friends tell funny jokes.

Sarah loved the book. She read it all the time. Then something strange happened. The book gave Sarah a special power. She could control other people. She was like the boy in the book. During one exam, she made her friend tell silly jokes. Her friend got in trouble.

After school, Sarah did not make a direct trip home. On the way, she went to the local store. She wanted to play more tricks on people. She caused problems. She made people fall down. She laughed and had fun.

Finally she left and started to walk home. Then she saw something. Her basketball coach was about to walk in front of a bus. He was looking the other way. She had to stop him! She used her power. She controlled him. She made him stop walking.

Sarah learned something that day. It was better to help people than make them suffer. So, she put a limit on how she used her power. She did not want to do bad things with it anymore. She only wanted to do good.

sections.title: Answer the questions based on the story.

questions.content: 1. What is this story about?
options: A girl who gets a novel about technology in the mail
A basketball coach who tells jokes to people
A man who takes a direct trip to the local store
A girl who can control other people
questions.correctAnswer: A girl who can control other people
questions.explanation: Câu chuyện kể về một cô bé có khả năng điều khiển người khác.

questions.content: 2. Why does Sarah love to read?
options: It gives her control over other people.
She likes the phrases and descriptions in books.
She likes to tell jokes to her teachers.
She wants to be a poet.
questions.correctAnswer: She likes the phrases and descriptions in books.
questions.explanation: Sarah thích đọc vì cô thích các cụm từ và sự miêu tả trong sách.

questions.content: 3. What does Sarah learn in the end?
options: She should make other people suffer.
Simple stories are the best.
She must limit her power.
She should not read during an exam.
questions.explanation: Cuối cùng, Sarah học được rằng cô phải giới hạn sức mạnh của mình.

questions.content: 4. What is true about the magical book?
options: It is printed on sheets of gold.
Its outline is hard to understand.
It gives examples of good jokes.
Sarah doesn’t want to write in it.
questions.correctAnswer: It is printed on sheets of gold.
questions.explanation: Quyển sách kỳ diệu được in trên những trang vàng.

questions.content: 5. Why is Sarah on the basketball team?
options: Her parents made her join the basketball team.
She loves to play basketball.
Her coach made her play.
She wants to beat her friends.
questions.correctAnswer: Her parents made her join the basketball team.
questions.explanation: Bố mẹ cô ép cô tham gia đội bóng rổ.
